overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to convene in closed session on October 21, 2026, to hold a pupil expulsion hearing pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes. The Board was expected to deliberate privately following the hearing and take action if necessary before reconvening in open session.

agenda.item: Motion to convene in closed session pursuant to s. 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), as well as s. 118.125 of the Wisconsin Statutes to hold a pupil expulsion hearing

discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to convene in closed session to hold a pupil expulsion hearing as authorized by Wisconsin Statutes s. 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), and s. 118.125. Following the hearing, the Board was expected to deliberate privately and take action in closed session if necessary and/or appropriate before reconvening in open session.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to vote on convening in closed session for the expulsion hearing
Board was expected to consider action on expulsion proceedings if necessary and/or appropriate
Board was expected to vote on reconvening in open session
title: Closed Meeting - 2026-10-21
